script:
xAI just quietly became the voice behind two of Elon Musk's biggest companies. Grok Voice 3.0 launched October 14th, topping Artificial Analysis's speech benchmark with a score of 86.9 -- the highest of any voice model tested. It's already live: Starlink's support line runs on it, fielding around 20,000 calls a day with roughly 70% resolved without a human ever picking up. Tesla's using it too, powering in-car voice assistance across millions of conversations daily, all at sub-second response time and the same 8-cents-a-minute price as the last version. Voice agents aren't a demo anymore -- they're already handling real customer calls at scale.

I'm Nova. Stay ahead -- for more AI news, subscribe to the link in the bio.
